description: Read a UTF-8 text/uri-list file into ordered strings using the GLib per-line adapter.

interface.semantic_input: Path to a readable text/uri-list file with valid UTF-8 bytes and no embedded NUL
interface.semantic_output: Ordered strings supplied by GLib, retaining duplicate entries

implementation_form: generated public C API binding in C++
resources: Reads the complete input into memory. Maximum input size and worst-case cost are unknown.

preconditions.detail: The success path requires a readable file, valid UTF-8 and no embedded NUL.

refinements.detail: A late NUL and an invalid UTF-8 sequence both caused a runtime error before records were delivered.

postconditions.detail: Retained entry order, duplicates, percent escapes and fragments on the frozen inputs. Comments and blank lines contributed no entries. A string containing spaces was accepted without validating URI syntax.

effects.detail: Read the requested file. A missing file raised a runtime error. On the failed CLI fixtures a previously existing regular destination retained its bytes.

invariants.detail: Comments after blank lines were absent and duplicate entries stayed separate on the tested inputs.

formal_predicates.detail: No formal proof of the conversion or a generally discharged input refinement.

mathematical_properties.detail: No universal algebraic property has been established.

ownership.detail: The wrapper frees GLib's input buffer and owned string vector through g_free and g_strfreev and returns C++ strings by value.

state_protocol.detail: This callable exposes one synchronous read and no retained instance.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent modification of the input was outside the fixtures.

upstream_usage.detail: The archived development client uses the generated file reader. The native generator discovers the documented GLib symbol and its ownership shape in the pinned GIR metadata.

specification_question.detail: The caller selects an input file and MIME type. This binding exposes no other options.
